prompt_pack.primary_prompt:
FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEW ONLY. Camera locked at exact frontal-orthographic projection. ZERO perspective angle. ZERO 3/4 view. ZERO depth foreshortening. The ring is rendered as a flat circular ring shape with NO visible side thickness, NO angled rim, NO depth recession. The viewer sees the ring's flat front face only — like a coin viewed straight-on, not like a coin viewed from above.

SUSPENSION: the ring is FLOATING / SUSPENDED in an infinite porcelain-white void. NO floor. NO pedestal. NO platform. NO table. NO ground plane. NO ellipse beneath the ring. NO shadow plane. NO cast shadow on any surface. The ring does NOT stand on anything. The ring does NOT rest on anything. The ring is held in space by nothing. The ring is mid-air. The ring is weightless.

VOID: infinite uniform porcelain-white #FAFAFA fills the ENTIRE frame edge to edge. NO horizon line. NO floor line. NO ceiling line. NO gradient. NO darkness. NO black background. NO gray background. NO gray gradient. NO studio backdrop. NO spotlight halo. The whiteness is total — top edge, bottom edge, left edge, right edge of the frame are ALL the same porcelain-white. If you sampled any pixel outside the ring's silhouette, it would be #FAFAFA.

SCALE READ: architectural-scale portal / substrate gate / cathedral-sized opening into the void. NOT a product object. NOT jewelry. NOT a prop. NOT a tabletop object. NOT a ring-for-fingers. The ring is monumental — like the gate of a temple or the aperture of a particle accelerator or the opening of a Tsutomu Nihei megastructure. Implied scale anchor: building, not accessory.

PRIMARY MOTIF: a Mechanical Enso ring — a perfect single calligraphic circle stroke — centered exactly at frame center. Ring outer diameter occupies ~60-70% of frame height. ONE ring only. NO multiple rings. NO concentric pairs. NO broken arcs. NO partial circles. NO kintsugi seams (that is Mikage Phase 2 signature, NOT LORA).

SYNCHRONIZATION LIGHT: ONE thin cold-cyan #00C8FF line traces the inner circumference of the ring. Uniform thickness. No flicker. No break. NO additional cyan accents anywhere else on the ring or in the void. NO cyan indicator dots. NO cyan multi-segment pattern. NO outer glow halo.

MATERIAL: brushed B4C porcelain ceramic on the ring face. Matte low-specular finish. Subtle micro-grain visible. Shallow subsurface scattering. NOT chrome. NOT mirror metal. NOT glossy plastic. NOT vinyl. NOT lacquered finish.

SYMMETRY: absolute bilateral symmetry. Left half pixel-mirror of right half. Ring's geometric center exactly on frame's vertical center axis AND horizontal center axis.

PHASE 1 BASELINE: NO Golden Patch event. NO clean digital gold accent. Pre-intervention stillness. The ring is dormant, awaiting instruction.

COLOR DISCIPLINE: porcelain-white #FAFAFA field + single cold-cyan #00C8FF inner-edge line ONLY. NO warm color anywhere. NO amber. NO orange. NO warm gold. NO hero gold. NO crimson. NO electric violet. NO neon purple. NO black background. NO gray background. NO outer shadow.

ASPECT RATIO: cinematic anamorphic 2.76:1. Frame is WIDE — porcelain-white void extends horizontally far past the ring on both sides.

MOOD: system at rest. Root infrastructure at the threshold of intervention. Architectural portal visualization, not a product shoot. Absolute sterile silence.
